description: CAM-54 slice-3: real CodexAdapter (codex exec spawn-argv) + per-phase adapter selection wiring readPhaseBackend to actual dispatch.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Verified against the real installed codex-cli 0.144.6. `codex exec [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]` is the non-interactive analog to claude. Confirmed flags: -s/--sandbox {read-only|workspace-write|danger-full-access}, --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox, -m/--model, -c key=value config override (used for model_instructions_file), -o/--output-last-message (optional, NOT the completion contract). No --agent flag and no caller-minted session-id flag exist; --ask-for-approval is set via -c/approval config. Confirms all six ADR-0047 mismatch resolutions in the issue spec.

userStories.title: Implement CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv for all four worker actors
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need a real CodexAdapter that emits codex-exec spawn-argv for implementer/planner/auditor/reviewer so codex can be a worker backend, without changing the claude path.
acceptanceCriteria: A CodexAdapter class implementing BackendAdapter exists in src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts. [oracle: grep -q 'class CodexAdapter' src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts]

buildSpawnArgv returns a `codex exec` command string for each of the four WorkerActors (implementer, planner, auditor, reviewer), covered by argv-shape tests. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts]

The codex argv uses `codex exec` with a --sandbox (or -s) mode and an approval directive (--ask-for-approval never via -c, or --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox) derived from the same permissionMode/isolation inputs claude uses, -m <model> from opts.model, and -c model_instructions_file=<tmpfile>. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts]

The tmpfile referenced by model_instructions_file holds the .claude/agents/<agentName>.md body with YAML frontmatter stripped, and is written under /tmp (never under .claude/, to avoid tripping the plan preflight clean-tree guard). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts]

CodexAdapter emits NO --session-id flag and NO claude-style `env -u CLAUDECODE...` nesting-guard strip; the codex env prefix derives from a codex-specific unset list that may be empty for host isolation. [oracle: test asserts codex argv contains neither '--session-id' nor 'CLAUDECODE']

For the codex backend the uuid input is accepted but not threaded into any session-id flag; completion detection stays the existing uniform worker-report.json + CAM_*_STATUS/<review> contract (no read-side change in this story). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
ClaudeAdapter argv remains byte-identical: the existing golden characterization tests still pass unchanged. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Core adapter logic. Edit src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts (add CodexAdapter class implementing the existing BackendAdapter interface + a codex-specific env-unset constant, e.g. CODEX_WORKER_ENV_UNSET, possibly empty). Reuse the module's existing shellEscape for the prompt. New test file test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts mirroring test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts golden style (pin literal argv strings per actor). Frontmatter strip: reuse/extend src/templates/frontmatter.ts (rewriteFrontmatterModel already isolates the `---...---` block via regex; add a stripFrontmatter that returns the body only) rather than parsing YAML (pattern-records: js-yaml v5 ESM-only breaks vendored scripts, and the CAM-53 rewriter-regex pattern). Temp file: write via node:fs writeFileSync to /tmp (deliberate sync point-read/write is allowed per Bun-only invariant; issue gotcha: never under .claude/). Sandbox/approval derivation maps permissionMode ('bypassPermissions' etc.) + isolation to codex flags per issue spec F5: --sandbox {read-only|workspace-write|danger-full-access}, --ask-for-approval never, or --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox; codex auth is OPENAI_API_KEY/CODEX_API_KEY, and codex has NO CLAUDECODE nesting guard so no recursion strip. ADR-0047 F2/F4/F5/F6 are the authoritative mismatch resolutions; re-read relatedDocs before coding. Keep the adapter output host/container agnostic (dockerExecWrap wraps at the call site, outside buildSpawnArgv). No live codex run.

userStories.title: Add selectAdapter(backend) factory and wire the four dispatch call sites
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need readPhaseBackend(phase) to actually choose ClaudeAdapter vs CodexAdapter at each dispatch site so per-phase backend selection stops being a dead-end event-only value.
acceptanceCriteria: A selectAdapter(backend) factory in src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts returns ClaudeAdapter for 'claude', CodexAdapter for 'codex', and defaults to ClaudeAdapter for any unknown value. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts]

The four dispatch call sites (loop.ts implementer, review.ts reviewer, plan-runner.ts planner + auditor) construct their adapter through selectAdapter() using the already-resolved readPhaseBackend(phase) value instead of hardcoding `new ClaudeAdapter()` or the thin wrapper. [oracle: grep -q 'selectAdapter' src/supervisor/loop.ts src/supervisor/review.ts src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts]
When backend is 'claude' the argv produced through the wired path is byte-identical to the pre-change claude argv (back-compat), asserted by tests for all four actors. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001. Add selectAdapter(backend: string): BackendAdapter to src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts. Wire call sites: loop.ts (~line 1014-1029, implBackend already read via readPhaseBackend('implementer'); replace buildImplementerWorkerArgv(...) with selectAdapter(implBackend).buildSpawnArgv('implementer', opts)); review.ts (~line 338-349, reviewBackend already resolved); plan-runner.ts (~line 595-597 planner and ~632-634 auditor, backend already read via readPhaseBackend). The thin wrappers buildImplementerWorkerArgv/buildReviewerWorkerArgv/buildPlannerWorkerArgv/buildAuditorWorkerArgv may stay as claude-only convenience but the call sites must route through selectAdapter so codex is reachable. Keep dockerExecWrap wrapping OUTSIDE the adapter (unchanged). Do NOT re-read readPhaseBackend at the call site if already resolved (loop/review/plan-runner already avoid double-read for the spawn-resolution event). Back-compat test: assert selectAdapter('claude').buildSpawnArgv(actor, opts) equals the existing goldens per actor.

userStories.title: Graceful token-ceiling degradation for the codex backend
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need the claude-shaped per-worker token-ceiling backstop to skip with a logged notice when the implementer backend is codex, so a codex worker never crashes or silently breaks on the missing .jsonl transcript.
acceptanceCriteria: When the resolved implementer backend is 'codex', the token-ceiling backstop path in src/supervisor/loop.ts logs a token-ceiling-unavailable notice and skips, rather than calling readWorkerTokens over a claude .jsonl transcript. [oracle: bun test]
When the resolved backend is 'claude' the existing token-ceiling behavior is unchanged (still enforces maxWorkerTokens when > 0 and a reader is wired). [oracle: bun test]
The codex path degrades gracefully: it never throws and never silently ignores the gap without emitting the notice. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002. Edit src/supervisor/loop.ts token-ceiling block (~line 1216-1256): gate the `maxWorkerTokens > 0 && readWorkerTokens` backstop on the resolved implBackend being 'claude' (implBackend is already read at ~line 1014). For 'codex', emit a one-time token-ceiling-unavailable notice (reuse the existing event emitter `emit(...)` / logging path used around worker-token-ceiling) and skip the poll-loop token check. To keep this unit-testable, extract a tiny pure predicate (e.g. shouldApplyTokenCeiling(backend, maxWorkerTokens, hasReader): boolean) and unit-test it directly, then call it in loop.ts. ADR-0047 Consequences explicitly leaves the token-ceiling backstop as an open risk to resolve here via graceful degradation (a real codex usage parser is a separate future slice, F3). Do not attempt to parse codex usage.
